name: CartRetain Recovery for WooCommerce
author: shoivehossain

sections.description:
CartRetain Recovery for WooCommerce is a simple, privacy-respecting WooCommerce abandoned cart tracker. It lets you monitor guests and logged-in users who added items to their cart but did not complete a purchase.

Lite Features

  • View a list of all abandoned carts in your WooCommerce store
  • Write Manual Rescue Emails — Send up to 5 custom recovery emails directly from the dashboard!
  • See cart contents, cart totals, and the date/time of abandonment
  • Tracks both guest users (via email capture on checkout) and logged-in users
  • Automatically marks carts as “recovered” when an order is placed
  • Clean, native WordPress admin dashboard UI
  • Lightweight — no external API calls or third-party tracking

PRO Features (Upgrade Required)

Want more power? Upgrade to Abandoned Cart PRO for:

  • ✅ Unlimited Manual Emails
  • ✅ Full Email Reveal — See the complete email address of every abandoner
  • ✅ Automated Recovery Email Sequences — Send follow-up emails automatically
  • ✅ AI Retention Engine — Smart embedded AI generates recovery emails for you
  • ✅ Advanced Analytics & Reporting — Revenue trends, recovery rates, and more
  • ✅ CSV Export — Export all abandoned cart data
  • ✅ Priority Support

Get PRO →

For inquiries, contact: shoivehossain100@gmail.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cartretain-recovery-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active — this plugin requires it.
  4. Navigate to Abandoned Carts from your WordPress admin menu to start monitoring.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send any emails?

Yes! The Lite version allows you to send up to 5 manual recovery emails directly from the interactive dashboard. For unlimited manual emails, automated email recovery, and AI-powered sales copy, you can upgrade to the PRO version.

Does this plugin work for guest users?

Yes! Guest users are tracked once they type their email on the WooCommerce checkout page. The email is captured before the order is submitted.

Does it track carts in real-time?

Yes. Cart data is updated immediately when a user adds or modifies cart contents and provides their email.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin stores only the cart data and email address of users who interact with the checkout. No data is sent to external servers. You should update your site’s privacy policy to disclose that cart data is retained.

Why are full email addresses hidden?

To encourage responsible data privacy practices in the free version. Only the email domain (e.g., ***@gmail.com) is shown. However, you can still securely send manual emails to them through the dashboard! Full email access is available in the PRO version.
